faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions quickly

whatIs.question: What is TaskFlow?
whatIs.answer: TaskFlow is a collaborative task management web application. It allows you to create, organize, and track tasks as a team with prioritization, filtering, and reporting features.

howToCreate.question: How do I create a new task?
howToCreate.answer: Click the '+ New Task' button from the dashboard or tasks page. Fill in the title, description, priority, and due date, then save.

priorities.question: What are the different priorities available?
priorities.answer: There are 4 priority levels: Low (LOW), Medium (MEDIUM), High (HIGH), and Urgent (URGENT). Use them to organize your work by importance.

statuses.question: What are the possible statuses of a task?
statuses.answer: A task can have 4 statuses: To Do (TODO), In Progress (IN_PROGRESS), Done (DONE), or Cancelled (CANCELLED). These statuses allow you to track the progress of your projects.

assignTask.question: How do I assign a task to someone?
assignTask.answer: When creating or editing a task, select a team member in the 'Assigned to' field. Only registered users can be assigned.

dashboard.question: What is the dashboard for?
dashboard.answer: The dashboard provides an overview of your tasks: statistics, overdue tasks, urgent tasks, upcoming tasks, and team workload distribution.

filters.question: How do I use filters?
filters.answer: In the tasks page, use filters by status, priority, and assignee to refine your view. You can also use the search bar to find specific tasks.

multiLanguage.question: Is TaskFlow available in multiple languages?
multiLanguage.answer: Yes, TaskFlow is available in French and English. You can change the language from your settings or via the selector in the header.

deleteTask.question: Can I delete a task?
deleteTask.answer: Currently, it is not possible to permanently delete a task. However, you can mark it as 'Cancelled' to remove it from your active views.

security.question: Is my data secure?
security.answer: Yes, TaskFlow uses standard security practices: passwords hashed with bcrypt, secure sessions, CSRF protection, and HTTPS connection (in production).
